title: TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
abstract: arXiv:2611.26619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid architectures have become mainstream among open-weight language models. Their global-attention and bounded-state layers maintain heterogeneous caches whose demands vary with context length and concurrency. We present TideCache, a serving system on CPU--GPU superchips with three components for allocating GPU memory among caches and managing their residency across GPU and host memory. The Transparent Cache Pool redistributes physical pages among cache components behind fixed virtual addresses, preserving cache layouts and backend interfaces. The Cache Streamer uses computation intervals provided by bounded-state layers to prefetch the next global-attention layer's prefix into GPU slots shared across global-attention layers, reducing GPU residency while overlapping layer-wise transfers with computation. translated_title: TideCache：具有透明缓存管理与逐层流式传输的高效混合LLM服务系统
translated_abstract: 混合架构已成为开源权重语言模型的主流。其全局注意力层与有界状态层维护着异构缓存，其缓存需求随上下文长度和并发度变化。我们提出TideCache，一个面向CPU-GPU超级芯片的服务系统，包含三个组件，用于在各类缓存之间分配GPU显存，并管理它们在GPU与主机内存之间的驻留。透明缓存池在固定虚拟地址之后于各缓存组件间重新分配物理页面，从而保持缓存布局和后端接口不变。缓存流式传输器利用有界状态层提供的计算间隔，将下一个全局注意力层的前缀预取到由各全局注意力层共享的GPU插槽中，在减少GPU显存驻留的同时将逐层数据传输与计算重叠。已生成的KV保持驻留。请求调度器选择驻留或流式执行模式，并据此触发容量调整。
tldr: TideCache是面向CPU-GPU超级芯片上混合架构LLM的服务系统，通过透明缓存池、逐层缓存流式传输和请求调度三大组件，动态管理异构缓存的显存分配与驻留，并将数据传输与计算重叠，从而实现高效服务。
en_tdlr: TideCache is a serving system for hybrid-architecture LLMs on CPU-GPU superchips that dynamically manages heterogeneous cache allocation and residency through a transparent cache pool, layer-wise cache streaming, and a request scheduler, overlapping data transfers with computation for efficient serving.
